bundled with Preact 10 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2015-present Jason Miller). Vendored unmodified; no build step.

fonts/PlusJakartaSans-latin.woff2, fonts/PlusJakartaSans-latin-ext.woff2: Plus Jakarta Sans, variable weight
(npm "@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans" 5.0.20), SIL Open Font License 1.1, see fonts/LICENSE-PlusJakartaSans.txt.
Fonts are self-hosted because the front door's CSP allows fonts from 'self' only.
